text:
Sam (oncall): Alert at 2026-06-10T04:20 UTC — dedicated-us-west-2 GPU pool reported rapid scale-down leaving queued inference requests and ~2.5% 429s for Dedicated customers. Declaring incident. Severity: S2. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2234501234

autoscale-bot: alert: dedicated_pool_underscale detected for pool=dedicated-us-west-2 at 04:20:11 UTC (desired=48 actual=32).

Infra: I'm checking the autoscaler policy history. Quick note: an autoscale-policy change landed in last deploy that lowered max_unneeded_padding from 0.25 -> 0.05. Rolling it back as emergency mitigation. Command: `infractl set-config autoscaler.max_unneeded_padding=0.25 --pool dedicated-us-west-2`

deploy-bot: config change applied at 04:23:02 UTC  autoscaler.max_unneeded_padding 0.05->0.25  status: success.

Frank: After the change p95 latency for dedicated endpoints fell from 1.2s -> 520ms; 429s dropped from 2.5% -> 0.2% in 5m. However we still have a queue backlog of ~12k requests. I'm enabling burst-capacity for 10m to drain backlog: `infractl pool burst-enable --pool dedicated-us-west-2 --minutes 10 --extra_nodes 8`

Beth: Burst-capacity enabled at 04:27:10 UTC. Nodes provisioning; healthchecks passing.

Telemetry: Query: `sum(rate(dedicated_429_total[1m])) by (pool)` shows steady decline. Posting short graph: https://telemetry.redwood.ai/d/graphs/dedicated-us-west-2-backlog

Infra: Root cause initial hypothesis: the autoscaler lint accidentally shipped a more aggressive downsizing config. Follow-ups: revert config gating, add a preflight that rejects max_unneeded_padding < 0.15 in prod, and add canary for autoscaler policy changes.

CS: Sending customer notice to affected enterprises and updating status page: "We experienced degraded capacity in dedicated-us-west-2 causing transient 429s; mitigations applied and backlog draining. RCA forthcoming." Draft: https://redwood.app/internal/comms/2234501234

Frank: Draining rate currently ~2.8k reqs/min, estimated clear in ~5 minutes. Will monitor for autoscaler chatter.

Sam (oncall): Scheduling a 45m RCA at 08:00 UTC. Owners: Infra (policy), Frank (drain), Telemetry (dashboards), CS (customer comms). Current status: mitigated (backlog draining, service stable). Closing thread unless recurrence. Thanks all :thumbsup:
